maxBytesPerDocument.description: Per-document text budget in bytes; absent means the server default.

source.description: Which text to return. Defaults to the effective (open-buffer) text.

ReadSource.description:
Inbound-only, but `Serialize` too: schemars emits a field's `default` only
when it can serialize the default value, and callers should see it.

oneOf.description: The open buffer when the document is open, otherwise disk.
The saved file, even when a dirty buffer exists.
